whyItMatters: A verification or locking control is switched off, so the integrity guarantees the ecosystem offers are not applied here. This rule reads a release profile that switches integer overflow checks off.
actions: Turn the control back on and fix what it reported instead of disabling the check. Specifically: fix a release profile that switches integer overflow checks off.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Cargo.toml no longer carries a release profile that switches integer overflow checks off.
